message.reasoning_content: We need to answer: "What has Henry Winkler worked as that Norman Foster has not?" Use evidence. Henry Winkler is an actor, also author, etc. Norman Foster is an architect. Evidence includes Henry Winkler starring in films, being a children's TV series author? Actually evidence: Henry Winkler is in Night Shift (film) starring actor. Also Henry Winkler is author of books (Hank Zipzer series). He also appears as Mr. Rock. So he works as an actor, also as a writer. Norman Foster is an architect. So what has Henry Winkler worked as that Norman Foster has not? Likely "actor". Evidence: Night Shift sentence says "It stars Howard's 'Happy Days' co-star Henry Winkler". Also "Cop and a Half is a 1993 American buddy cop-comedy film directed by Henry Winkler". That shows he directed a film. Norman Foster is not a film director. So answer could be "film director". Evidence: Cop and a Half sentence: "Cop and a Half is a 1993 American buddy cop-comedy film directed by Henry Winkler". Norman Foster is not a director. So answer: He has worked as a film director. Provide citation. Use that sentence. Also could use "actor". But which is more distinct? Both are not done by Foster. Choose one. Provide answer: "He has worked as a film director". Cite Cop and a Half sentence. Also maybe mention Night Shift as actor. But need only one citation. Provide list of [title, sentence index]. For Cop and a Half: title "Cop and a Half", sentence_id 0. So citation: ["Cop and a Half",0]. Answer string: "film director".
